description: This Kotlin source file defines tools for managing and displaying tool configurations and summaries within an Android application. It includes data classes for representing tool display specifications, loading configuration from assets, resolving tool summaries, and utility functions for string manipulation and JSON parsing.

classes.name: ToolDisplayActionSpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing an action specification for tool display.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySpec
classes.description: Serializable data class representing a tool display specification, including emoji, title, label, detail keys, and actions.

classes.name: ToolDisplayConfig
classes.description: Serializable data class representing the overall configuration for tool displays, including version, fallback specification, and tools map.

classes.name: ToolDisplaySummary
classes.description: Data class representing a summarized view of a tool, including computed properties for display lines.

classes.name: ToolDisplayRegistry
classes.description: Singleton object managing loading, resolving, and caching tool display configurations and summaries.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Main method to resolve and generate a ToolDisplaySummary based on context, tool name, arguments, and optional metadata.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads the tool display configuration from assets, with caching.

methods.name: titleFromName
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly title from a tool name.

methods.name: normalizeVerb
methods.description: Normalizes action verbs by trimming and replacing underscores.

methods.name: readDetail
methods.description: Constructs a detail string for read actions based on arguments.

methods.name: firstValue
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty value from arguments given a list of keys.

methods.name: valueForPath
methods.description: Fetches a nested value from arguments based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Renders a JSON value as a string, with truncation and preview capabilities.

methods.name: shortenHomeInString
methods.description: Replaces home directory paths with '~' for display purposes.

methods.name: asStringOrNull
methods.description: Extension method to convert a JsonElement to a string if possible.

methods.name: asNumberOrNull
methods.description: Extension method to convert a JsonElement to a number if possible.
